    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(-5.81 * vars['Var_6'] >= -47.95, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(5.26 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.79 * vars['Var_3'] >= 57.03, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(7.04 * vars['Var_0'] + -8.92 * vars['Var_1'] + 5.53 * vars['Var_4'] + -9.93 * vars['Var_5'] + 9.36 * vars['Var_6'] + -3.02 * vars['Var_8'] >= -5.54, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(7.96 * vars['Var_0'] + -2.03 * vars['Var_2'] + -0.77 * vars['Var_3'] + 6.8 * vars['Var_5'] + -7.13 * vars['Var_8'] >= -49.52, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(-6.61 * vars['Var_0'] + -1.72 * vars['Var_2'] >= -17.25, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(3.65 * vars['Var_6'] + -3.04 * vars['Var_8'] >= 11.56, name='C5')

    m.optimize()
